colfin22.notes:
This one caused me a fair bit of grief. On 2.10.0b13 my OpenSubsonic provider pointing at Navidrome stopped working completely. Reconfiguring the provider threw type object 'Extensions' has no attribute 'STRUCTURED_LYRICS', and the same error took out provider setup and library sync.
The part that cost me time is that it presents as an auth failure. I went looking at my Navidrome credentials first, because that is what a provider that will not connect normally means. The credentials were fine the whole time.
The cause is that sonic_provider.py calls OpenSubsonicExtensions.STRUCTURED_LYRICS while the pinned py-opensonic==10.3.0 only defines SONG_LYRICS. That member does not exist at any version, so it fails every time rather than intermittently.
I was stuck on it for a while because rolling back was not a real option. Stable 2.9.11 is a separate add-on with its own data directory, so going back would have meant rebuilding my whole setup from scratch. I ended up just waiting for a fixed build.
Worth flagging that a missing enum member on a hot path takes out three things at once and gives no hint that it is a code bug rather than a config problem.
